_why: DECLARED DEPENDENCIES. This child may import its own files plus these, and NOTHING else. gitEr/unhitch.sh enforces it in a sterile room where ReTreever does not exist. Adding a line here is a DECISION, not a formality: anything starting with $lib, $tinyStore or $mobRoutes, or climbing into ReTreever, is a NO.
_channel_why: THE CHANNEL. One door to the host. The child names the channel, never ReTreever. A host wires its real implementation in; the harness wires a fixture. Anything the channel does not provide comes back null and the child renders nothing rather than crashing. Every $-import outside this prefix is a SECOND DOOR and unhitch.sh reports it. CHANGED IN RAPPER PHASE 1: this used to name $harness/mapShared/ — a folder SHARED by every child. mapShared is gone; its modules went DOWN into the children that actually used them, so the channel is now a path INSIDE this child and travels with it when the child is lifted.
